svg.title: Annual total ecosystem respiration (TER, = Reco) against annual gross primary production (GPP), one marker per site-year; below the 1:1 line the site-year was a net CO2 sink. The point labels (year and crop) are not shown in this variant.
svg.desc: Scatter plot of 15 site-years (full and reliable years with annual GPP and TER): x axis annual GPP (g C m−2 yr−1), y axis annual total ecosystem respiration (TER, = Reco; g C m−2 yr−1), both from 600 to 1600 on the same scale. A dotted 1:1 line divides net source years (above, NEE > 0) from net sink years (below, NEE < 0); faint grid lines every 200. Annual GPP is 660 to 1479, TER 612 to 1465 g C m−2 yr−1. 9 site-years are below the line and 6 above it. NEE is −73 ± 155 (mean ± SD, range −392 to 131, n = 15) g C m−2 yr−1; the strongest sink is Maktau 2019 maize with NEE −392, the strongest source Haltiala 2023 grass (failed) with NEE 131. OLS line: TER = 0.67 × GPP + 262, r = 0.75 (n = 15); without Maktau slope 0.66, r = 0.84 (n = 14). Each site has its own colour and marker; the points have no labels. The site-years (year and, for annual crops and the failed grass, the crop) are: Anttila 2022, 2023; Särkisuo 2022; Haltiala 2022 oats, 2023 grass (failed), 2024 sunflower, 2025 oats; Qvidja 2020, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025; Viikki 2024, 2025 faba bean; Maktau 2019 maize.
